projects.notes: VDOT Six-Year Improvement Program (SYIP) approved projects. HAS_PE / HAS_RW / HAS_CN flag preliminary-engineering, right-of-way and construction phases; PE_START_DATE, RW_START_DATE, CN_START_DATE, CN_END_DATE are phase dates; CURRENT_PE_ESTIMATE / CURRENT_RW_ESTIMATE / CURRENT_CN_ESTIMATE and TOTAL_EST_CURRENT are cost estimates. Planned vs under construction: POOL_PRJ_STATUS_DSC (see values) and CN_START_DATE in the future. HAS_RW='1' with a future RW_START_DATE marks upcoming right-of-way acquisition.

parcels_counties.notes: Prince William County open-data parcels joined to CAMA; 156,428 of 160,086 rows have an owner (names look truncated at about 30 characters). The CAMA_ADDRESS*/CAMA_CITY/STATE/ZIPCODE fields appear to be the owner's mailing address (not confirmed by documentation). No value field.

Chesterfield County 'ParcelsEnriched' layer (county ArcGIS Online org); 150,861 of 151,015 rows have OwnerName (rows without it are non-parcel polygons with all-null attributes). TotalAssessment also present.

summary: VDOT's SYIP approved-projects line and point layers verify with status, scope, cost and right-of-way/construction phase dates. The VGIN statewide parcel layer (https://vginmaps.vdem.virginia.gov/arcgis/rest/services/VA_Base_Layers/VA_Parcels/FeatureServer/0, 4,174,364 parcels, verified) has only FIPS, LOCALITY, PARCELID, no owner. Owner names verified for Prince William and Chesterfield only; Fairfax's open-data parcel layer has no owner fields, and the Loudoun, Virginia Beach and Henrico servers timed out from the research network.
